title: SyntaxMind at BLP-2025 Task 1: Leveraging Attention Fusion of CNN and GRU for Hate Speech Detection
measurement_description: Detection of 'Religious Hate' speech as one of several categories in a multi-class hate speech classification task.
findings: The paper's model was evaluated on a dataset that includes a 'Religious Hate' category. This category was identified as a minority class, constituting only 1.9% of the dataset, which presents a challenge for model generalization and can lead to biased predictions favoring majority classes.
